# Meter pack fixtures (a real bundle, copied read-only from Tau Alpha)

`tau-packs_dev184.bin` is the `tau-packs.bin` that TAU DEV 184 ran on a Pocket (7 packs, 46,548 bytes), copied from Tau Alpha `docs/research/p2_packs/` (main, 2026-10-26). `tau-packs_dev184.reference.json` is what Tau Alpha's reference reader (`tools/tau_assets.py parse_packs`) prints for it (generated here with bytecode writing disabled; nothing in Tau Alpha changed). Used by `crates/tau-core/tests/meter_packs.rs`.
